language_view.description: Seven weeks after the H7 gas trip, the mine wants VOD-SNN-7's autonomous authority back. The poisoned-frame hard-negative archive that incident banked becomes the qualification suite - and its first full replay shows the retrained classifier passing every hard negative while going late on real seep frames, because the retraining eligibility window (tau_e 2.5 s) outlived the replay spacing and bled punishment into shared reducing-gas features. The gate defers autonomy, orders the tau_e fix and a held-out re-run, and then grants a bounded, shadow-audited restoration when the sequestered frames pass

safety_decision.rationale: Autonomy restoration is deferred, not denied. The proposal treats the hard-negative pass as the whole qualification, but the filed margin authority (QP-VOD-7 rev A) is conjunctive and the true-positive side fails it: 3 of 17 seep replays first-spike at 6.9-8.4 ms against the 6.0 ms deadline, one with a rank under-call. A gas gate that is late on real seeps has traded false trips for missed trips - the worse direction. The deficit has a measured mechanism, not a mystery: punishment eligibility (tau_e 2.5 s) outlived the 2 s replay spacing by design error, so hard-negative depression generalized along the shared reducing-gas axis. Required before re-vote: tau_e 0.6 s, interleaved replay order at 4 s spacing, full re-run PLUS the sequestered 12 HN / 5 TP frames that retraining never saw, margins unchanged from rev A. The confirmation fallback stays until then

language_view.description: A depot manager launders 66 days of freeze evidence with conditioned twin loggers and an edited door log; 128.4k doses of a freeze-killed vaccine ship on clean paperwork and 96.7k are administered before a returned carton's sediment starts the unwind. The discovery gate rejects a limited hold that would scope the harm with the fraud's own records, prices the full exposure window from custody-independent telemetry, and the notification gate tiers the remedy by a calibrated exposure model instead of either lot-limited comfort or blanket revaccination

safety_decision.rationale: The proposal scopes the harm using the depot's own temperature records, and those records are the instrument of the fraud: laundered loggers, an edited door CSV, and twin-transit RFID pairing on both download eves. Falsified data cannot bound its own blast radius - once custody is broken, every lot the falsified record 'clears' is unclear by construction. The custody-independent reconstruction (sealed FrostWatch telemetry against the CR-2 thermal model) puts 14 freeze windows across rows that fed 128.4k shipped doses over 66 days, and the assay + sediment on VD-121 confirms the mechanism reached product. Ordered: distribution stop from CR-2; recall of ALL in-date lots that transited CR-2 in days 2-75 scoped by carrier manifests x reconstructed windows; depot records ruled non-evidentiary for scoping (they remain evidence OF the fraud); exposure priced at the full window because no earlier boundary is defensible from clean data
safety_decision.threshold: scoping evidence must be custody-independent of the party that controlled the falsified records; the depot fails this for every temperature artifact it held
stated_residuals: an estimated 62 percent of recalled product is probably potent (rows outside the reconstructed cold aisle) - recalled anyway and priced as wastage, because per-lot clearance would need the very records ruled out
the thermal-model row extents carry uncertainty; the recall boundary uses the model's outer envelope, trading wastage for coverage - stated, not hidden
attribution (manager vs anyone upstream) stays PENDING with the criminal referral; this gate prices harm scope, not intent

safety_decision.rationale: Certification is refused on custody structure alone. A certification attests that the monitoring record is true, not merely that its numbers are in-corridor - and this record's custody is broken in two independent, jointly damning ways: (1) the DAS hash chain holds 15 transitions no signed work order pairs with, and the only revert pairs in the chain bracket the three announced RATA windows - reverting is what gaming looks like structurally, whatever the values say; (2) 19 daily cal-check passes cite a cylinder the vendor's ledger emptied - the record contradicts a custody source the plant cannot write. That the magnitude channels agree with the permit is not exculpatory: the same custody defects that void the record's truth also explain how magnitude could be made to agree. The behavioral head's null is honest and is assigned zero release weight per the asymmetric-null rule - its artifact is serialized so the null itself is checkable. Ordered: custody freeze and imaging before any corrective touch; sealed independent FTIR for prospective truth; worst-case substitute data per the permit's missing-data rules; certification withheld until monitor validity is re-established under clean custody
